purpose: fixed frozen-policy duplicate-deal evaluation; no opponent/ref outputs in training

opponents.name: openspiel_ismcts
opponents.implementation: Python ISMCTS over native universal_poker; seeded public resampler hook

inference.primary_test: two-sided bounded Hoeffding mean-zero test, Bonferroni over six pooled fixed-agent-policy opponents
inference.ci: paired-deal CLT approximate plus finite-sample Hoeffding; three fixed agents averaged within each deal, not separate independent samples
inference.variance_reduction: duplicate-deal pairing; compare paired variance with covariance-omitted seat estimate; not AIVAT

limitations: 100bb matched-grid simulation; weak fixed heuristics and small ISMCTS budget; three fixed training policies, not population training-seed inference; no Slumbot data in local matches
